about.name: Coach Isaac Eubanks
about.title: DC/DL
about.bio:
Coach Isaac Eubanks is a proven 4-2-5 specialist with 13 years of coaching experience at Middle Tennessee Christian School. Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Eubanks develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Eubanks's coaching is where that journey starts.

hero.headline: Middle Tennessee Christian School's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized defensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: 4-2-5 Defense Installation
services.description: Full 4-2-5 system installation — formations, assignments, stunts, and blitz packages tailored to your personnel.

services.title: Film & Opponent Scouting
services.description: Tendency charting, defensive game-planning, and film breakdown sessions that give your defense the edge before kickoff.

services.title: Defensive Line Technique
services.description: Hand placement, leverage, pass rush moves, and gap discipline for DL players who want to dominate at the line of scrimmage.
